title: Amazon just hiked the prices for Echo, Fire TV, and Kindle products by up to 60 percent
summary: Citing "significant increases in memory and storage component costs," Amazon has raised prices on Echos, Kindles, Fire TVs, and Eeros by up to 60 percent, as first reported by Fortune. The cheapest products in Amazon's lineup were hit hardest, with the Echo Dot smart speaker jumping from $49.99 to $79.99. The Fire TV Stick 4K […]
llm_summary: Amazon has raised the prices of many of its own devices—including Echo speakers, Kindle e‑readers, Fire TV sticks and Eero routers—by as much as 60 % after “significant” hikes in memory
